printedProse.1: The mighty God, the Lord, Has spoken unto all; From rising to the setting sun The nations hear His call.
printedProse.2: From Zion His abode, Where perfect beauty dwells, The Lord His glory has displayed In brightness that excels.
printedProse.3: Our God shall surely come, Nor silence shall He keep; Devouring fire shall herald Him, About Him storms shall sweep.
printedProse.4: Then to the heav'ns above He from His throne shall call, The earth His kingly voice shall hear, He is the Judge of all.
printedProse.5: Let all My chosen saints Before Me gathered be, Those that by sacrifice have sealed Their promise unto Me.
printedProse.6: Then shall the heavens declare His righteousness abroad, Because the Lord Himself is Judge, Yea, none is Judge but God.

songs.qualification: Stanzas 1–4 are literal RFPA underlay. Stanzas 5–6 are metrical editorial attachment of printed prose, including sung heavens elision; not literal engraved note attachment.
